components.question: Are genotype, ancestry, route and experimental units authenticated before phenotype scoring?
components.unit: documented stock, independent founder/run and eligible allele
components.denominator: all eligible founder/run records, including excluded and unresolved records
available_evidence: R27 supplement Table S3 strain and marker records
components.failure_rule: Do not infer genotype or origin from morphology, reporter state or colour; preserve unknown mappings.

components.question: How many eligible acquisition episodes arise per admitted opportunity exposure in this context?
components.unit: independently adjudicated acquisition episode with ancestry and exposure
components.denominator: admitted divisions/opportunities under an explicit assay and sampling model
available_evidence: R26 reported historical combined WS rate only
R27 Table S2 conventional model provenance
components.failure_rule: No selected winner/CFU/descendant frequency as mutation supply; no binomial jackpot counts without a justified law.

components.question: Does a known eligible lineage reach a predefined establishment state before terminal recovery?
components.unit: one known introduced lineage trial in a declared independent run, or an explicitly modelled cluster
components.denominator: independently verified introduced lineage trials, with failed introductions separately adjudicated
available_evidence: R26 introduced SM/WS observations and well-level rescue comparison
components.failure_rule: Final colony recovery cannot simultaneously define establishment and calibrate recovery; unknown fate remains unknown.

components.question: Does measured establishment depend on resident state, density or introduction timing under a defensible comparison?
components.unit: allocated independent run/block and its measured ecological state
components.denominator: all allocated runs in each declared block/context, with exclusions and interference recorded
available_evidence: R27 supplementary Methods: LB and ΔpvdS for selected imaging
R27 Table S3 integrated tags versus plasmid reporter
R26 genotype dates and source surface units
not_supplied: actual factor levels or experimental allocation
matched control grid across all routes
components.failure_rule: Do not pool different medium/background/date/protocol strata or regard deletion probes as exclusive interventions on one mediator.

components.question: What does the assay recover and call, conditional on known truth entering a named stage?
components.unit: known route/allele truth challenge at a declared assay stage, respecting its cluster
components.denominator: all independently verified challenges introduced at that stage in each route × context × phase
components.failure_rule: A late spike-in covers only later steps; scalar correct recovery cannot identify off-diagonal errors or native origin inclusion.

components.question: Are newly acquired, inherited/pre-existing and absent variants independently distinguished?
components.unit: truth-labelled acquisition episode or origin-negative variant in its parental lineage
components.denominator: complete predefined truth challenge frame, not only successful assay calls
available_evidence: Existing R21 native origin control distinction
R26 observed collapse as a loss mechanism
components.failure_rule: A true variant can be origin-negative; absent variants address different false positives; unknown or destroyed lineages are not certified origin-negative.

components.question: Do independently measured conventional mechanisms predict the same observed target vector?
components.unit: one complete frozen target-context probability vector per candidate model
components.denominator: same declared held-out observed conditional W/A/M frame and context weights
not_supplied: complete independently parameterized target W/A/M vector
components.failure_rule: A scalar curvature, historical combined rate or SM/WS model cannot replace the vector; q×F factorization needs admission and cannot be assumed for general races.

components.question: Does a frozen forecast improve or fail under admitted outcomes and existing decision rules?
components.unit: independent endpoint run with one predefined outcome, or another separately justified count law
components.denominator: every eligible held-out run, preserved in declared founder/batch clusters
available_evidence: Existing R3 prospective contract and later certified-score methods
components.failure_rule: No post-outcome fitting, cherry-picked contexts, refreshed alpha, pooled descendants or inference from non-rejection.

estimand_separation.primary_unchanged: declared-weight expected log-score gain per observed qualifying W/A/M endpoint
estimand_separation.biological_origin_target: separate blocked interpretation requiring independent acquisition truth and loss/transport controls
estimand_separation.all_category_forecast: would require a separately admitted and frozen complete observation model; no primary-score change here
estimand_separation.full_vector_requirement: Every conventional candidate must supply the same entire conditional W/A/M vector; J or K alone is insufficient.

preserved_model.shared_theta_across_C_contexts: C-1 restrictions under the existing assumptions
preserved_model.eta_for_full_forecast: must be frozen independently before target outcomes
preserved_model.conditional_factor_identity: Only under admitted positive q×F×r route-weight factorization; no transfer from expected mass to run winner or birth probability.

next_decision_order: Authenticate allele, marker, medium and experimental-unit joins.
Assess feasibility of independent episode truth and before-recovery establishment ascertainment.
Identify costed missing measurements only if they can change a specific admission gate.
Have qualified biological/statistical reviewers assess the complete proposed protocol and control transport.
Resolve the existing registries and freeze design/forecasts/uncertainty/stopping before independent held-out endpoints.
